xBRIEFInfo.description: Fail closed when triage:queue would render scanner-quarantined GitHub issue titles

plan.title: fix(triage): omit/sanitize quarantined cache titles in triage:queue

narratives.Description: triage:queue reads raw.json titles without consulting cache scan_result, so hard-fail quarantined issues and injection-shaped titles still reach the mandatory agent work-selection surface.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator or agent consulting task triage:queue, I want quarantined cache entries omitted or title-redacted so attacker-controlled issue titles cannot bypass the cache scanner into mandatory agent context.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. In loadCachedIssues, read meta.json scan_result and omit entries where passed is false. 2. Sanitize each candidate title through the cache scanner before enqueue: hard-fail omits the issue; injection-heading / shell-vector fence-and-pass replaces the title with a neutral placeholder. 3. Add unit tests for hard-fail omission and injection title redaction. 4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry. 5. task check / vitest for the touched suite.
narratives.Overview: cachePut always persists raw.json and only suppresses content.md on scanner hard-fail. loadCachedIssues currently copies payload.title from raw.json and renderQueue prints it. AGENTS.md requires agents to consult triage:queue, making this a mandatory context path.
narratives.GuardRails: Do not weaken live-open reconcile (#2238). Prefer reusing packages/core/src/cache/scanner.ts rather than a parallel title filter. Keep queue ranking/output shape for clean titles unchanged.

items.title: loadCachedIssues omits entries whose meta.json scan_result.passed is false.
Queue titles are scanner-sanitized; hard-fail omits, injection fence-and-pass redacts to a placeholder.
Regression tests cover hard-fail omission and injection title redaction.
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry documents the user-visible quarantine fix.
